{{Top|leg}}
'''Security point eleven''' was located on the the [[Chancellor Palpatine Spaceport]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="DR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>

Thirty [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], the battle that started the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] security guard Charpp was stationed at security point eleven of the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. He chanced upon [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Maks Leem]], who had lined up for his station. The Jedi Master at that time was working undercover for a [[Mission to Vjun (Clone Wars)|mission]] along with her companions, fellow Jedi Master [[Jai Maruk]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy]], Leem's own Padawan [[Whie Malreaux/Legends|Whie Malreaux]], and [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], who was hidden inside an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] as a disguise.<ref name="DR" />

Charpp took Leem aside after [[Security scanner/Legends|scanning]] the Jedi and told her that he recognized the unique signature readings of her hidden [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], thus deducing that Leem was a Jedi. When Leem confirmed her identity, Charpp became excited at the opportunity of meeting an actual Jedi and readily offered his help on her mission. Faced with an overeager admirer, Leem pretended that the Order knew Charpp was a loyal supporter of the Jedi; and that they specifically chose his security line for her to go through, knowing that he would not blow her cover. Ecstatic that he was able to help the Jedi on her mission, Charpp allowed Leem to go on her way.<ref name="DR" />
